slots.notes: Fullscreen object-cover looping background video behind the hero; fades in after a 2800ms delay, muted/autoplay/playsInline, pointer-events-none.

Set of 5 specimen/chapter images cycled in the dark section's left panel via the SandTransitionImage SVG-dissolve component (object-contain, mix-blend-lighten, transparent PNGs); auto-advances every 3500ms. Each pairs with a chapter name copy slot.
Oversized transparent-PNG specimen (pterodactyl) absolutely positioned to overlap upward between the light and dark sections; whileInView parallax from y:-65% to y:-78%, pointer-events-none.
Custom inline geometric letter-block wordmark (viewBox 0 0 840 100), full-width header logo built from per-letter polygons each animating up via the letterBlock variant; fill is the fg color.
Custom inline 4-path stylized leaf/plant icon inside the primary CTA button; white by default, turns fg color on hover with scale/rotate transform.
Lucide React line icons used across nav/pills/affordances: ArrowRight, Plus, ArrowUpRight, Bone, Dna, Gem, Leaf, BookOpen. Stroke-based, inherit current text color.
Inter (Google Fonts, weights 300/400/500/600) — drives display headlines, body, and the ultra-large text-mega utility (21vw). Single family serves both display and body roles.
JetBrains Mono (Google Fonts, weights 400/500) — all uppercase tracked mono labels, eyebrows, nav, stats, and counters.

mechanic: A single-scroll editorial museum hero: a letter-block SVG wordmark animates up over a delayed fullscreen looping video, then scroll drives an oversized transparent specimen that overlaps into a dark chapter browser whose images swap through an SVG feTurbulence sand-dissolve as the active chapter auto-cycles.
techDelivery: React 19 + Vite 6 + Tailwind CSS 4 (@theme tokens + @layer utilities) + Motion (Framer Motion) variants + Lucide React, TypeScript; entire page is one App.tsx plus an inline SandTransitionImage helper.
reskinNotes: Heavy reskin friction: the wordmark is hand-authored inline SVG polygons (per-letter geometry, not editable as text) and the CTA leaf is a 4-path inline SVG — both bake fill colors and shapes into markup. All copy (headline, chapter names, mission, stats, nav, footers) is hardcoded in JSX. The chapters array length (5) is wired into auto-cycle modulo and the 01/05 counter, so swapping image count requires code changes. Many one-off hex/rgba values are inline in Tailwind arbitrary classes (e.g. #1a1a1a, rgba(17,17,17,0.5), gray-800 borders) rather than theme tokens, and the text-mega/headline sizing is viewport-width and font-metric dependent (Inter tracking).
